description: Header file defining a priority task worker class and related executor classes for managing tasks with different priority levels, including thread management and task queue handling.

classes.name: priority_task_worker
classes.description: Manages task queues with different priorities, handling task execution and thread management.

classes.name: priority_task_worker_executor
classes.description: Executor class that schedules tasks with a predefined priority on a priority_task_worker.

methods.name: push_task
methods.description: Pushes a task into the queue with a specified priority.

methods.name: get_id
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the worker.

methods.name: worker_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the worker thread.

methods.name: queue_capacity
methods.description: Returns the capacity of the specified priority task queue.

methods.name: nof_priority_levels
methods.description: Returns the number of priority levels supported.

methods.name: run_pop_task_loop
methods.description: Main loop for popping and executing tasks based on priority.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a task, either inline if conditions permit or by pushing to the queue.

methods.name: defer
methods.description: Defers a task by pushing it into the queue.

methods.name: can_run_task_inline
methods.description: Determines if a task can be run inline based on thread and priority.
